site.title: Data Engineering Toolkit
site.subtitle: SingleStore Pipeline Automation Hub
site.description: A centralized toolkit for exporting pipelines, generating SQL, synchronizing configurations, and accelerating SingleStore development workflows.

categories.name: SingleStore
categories.blurb: Pipeline export, deployment and synchronization utilities.

categories.name: SQL Utilities
categories.blurb: Generate, review and execute SQL safely.

tools.name: Pipeline Export & Sync
tools.summary: Export every CREATE PIPELINE definition from a SingleStore database to a single idempotent .sql file, then re-apply it with a dry-run safety step.

tools.name: SQL Runner
tools.summary: Execute any .sql file against SingleStore statement by statement with progress, failure summary and --dry-run preview. Bundled with Pipeline Sync.

tools.name: SQL Generator
tools.summary: Generate DDL / pipeline SQL from templates and parameters.

tools.name: Configuration Sync
tools.summary: Diff and synchronize pipeline and table configuration between environments.

tools.name: Developer Utilities
tools.summary: Small helpers for day-to-day data engineering tasks.

tools.name: Best Practices
tools.summary: Guidelines for pipeline design, credentials handling and safe deployments.
